description: Renovate owns the Gradle version catalog only. The github-actions and dockerfile managers are deliberately off, because .github/dependabot.yml covers those and two bots on one manifest means two PRs for one bump.

packageRules.description: Kotlin, its compiler plugins and AGP move as one. A Kotlin bump without the matching Compose compiler plugin does not build, and AGP is the other half of that pairing.
AndroidX moves often and rarely interestingly. One batched PR a week, early Monday, so it lands before anyone is working.
The coroutines and serialization runtimes are versioned together upstream and are easier to review as one change.
The Gradle wrapper is pinned to what the build image ships. Raising it is a build-environment decision, so it gets its own PR and its own label rather than riding along with a library bump.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A known vulnerability does not wait for Monday.
